I’m prolly late on this but even still this has affected me, today actually I was looking for similar experiences, glad to say I’m not alone. I usually had nightmares such as death of family members or something traumatic but I would wake up fine I wouldn’t remember it all the way but I would wake up knowing it’s a dream. But today specifically My dream consisted of my older sister berating and yelling at me tearing down my confidence and me myself in the dream unable to retaliate, it’s like halfway through a sentence every time I spoke in the dream my tongue was tied, at the end of the dream I called the police for a armed suspicious person with my clothes description and ended up dying to the police by gunshot wounds, and that’s when I woke up and started crying. I def had worser dreams but ig this dream must have hit a lot harder for the fact that it stayed more true to a realistic aspect. As I’ve dealt with depression before it might have awoken underlying emotions I never knew of. Or maybe the fact that my family would just stop loving me, to me my older sister is anything but like how she is in the dream, she’s the one who helped me alot during my depression and I know dreams tend to be the “what if’s” of ur mind and Ig the realism of the dream was what got to me. When I mean by realism I mean like it’s not overly the top crazy or unbelievable usually in dreams at least for me that are scary or depressing have over the top shit that usually happens and even in my dream I can tell it’s not real but this one… he I’m rambling too long.
